capabilities: Insert TK placeholders with a command
Render TKs as chips in Live Preview and reading view
List open TKs in a side panel by note or vault
Accept, reject or reopen a TK from the panel
Filter and search TKs by status and text
disambiguation: Not a collaborative comment system; it marks TK placeholders in your own drafts and tracks their status.
extras: Status is stored in the note text itself, so it survives sync and works without the plugin. Excluded folders default to Archive and affect the panel only. The README says to install from Community plugins once the plugin is listed.
problem: Drafting leaves gaps that are easy to lose track of across a vault, with no built-in way to mark, review and close them.
summary: Writer's placeholder tool that shows [TK: ...] marks as chips in notes and tracks every open one in a side panel with status filters.
